The front and side views show a solid 20x20 rectangle with no cutouts, flanges, or bosses anywhere, confirming the part is a plain cylindrical disc extruded 20mm tall along Z. No notches, cutouts, or secondary features are visible from any direction, so the body stays a simple tube throughout. The construction is trivial: extrude the outer circle (R10) on the XY plane by 20mm, then extrude the inner circle (R6) as a cut. Both circles are centered at the origin. content.text:
The part is a simple solid cylinder (disc) throughout — all views show clean rectangles with no cutouts, flanges, or bosses. The top view reveals the only feature: a central hole (R6) inside the 20mm outer diameter (R10). The body extrudes 20mm along Z.

```python
import cadquery as cq

# Simple disc with central hole
outer_radius = 10
inner_radius = 6
height = 20

base_plane = cq.Plane(
    origin=(0, 0, 0),
    xDir=(1, 0, 0),
    normal=(0, 0, 1),
)

outer_body = (
    cq.Workplane(base_plane)
    .circle(outer_radius)
    .extrude(height)
)

inner_cut = (
    cq.Workplane(base_plane)
    .circle(inner_radius)
    .extrude(height)
)

result = outer_body.cut(inner_cut)
```
